# Neuro & Evil Karaoke API — Karaoke setlists

Base URL: https://api.neurokaraoke.com (Production)

Setlists from karaoke streams. A setlist is a playlist with `isSetlist = true`.

### `GET /api/playlists` — List playlists and setlists

Auth: none

Returns playlists. Set `isSetlist=true` to return only karaoke setlists. Paging, search, sorting and `year` behave the same as in the public playlist endpoint.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `startIndex` | query | `int` | no | default: 0 |
| `pageSize` | query | `int` | no | default: 30 |
| `search` | query | `string` | no |  |
| `sortBy` | query | `string` | no |  |
| `sortDescending` | query | `bool` | no | default: false |
| `isSetlist` | query | `bool` | no | default: false |
| `year` | query | `int` | no | default: 0 |

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  id?: string | null
  name?: string | null
  description?: string | null
  createdBy?: string | null
  updatedBy?: string | null
  media?: {
    id?: string | null
```

### `GET /api/playlist/recent` — Get the latest setlist

Auth: none

Returns the setlist from the most recent karaoke stream.

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

### `GET /api/setlists/stats` — Get setlist statistics

Auth: none

Returns aggregate statistics across all karaoke setlists, such as stream and song counts.

Response `200` OK
